description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Singed''' spills a potent adhesive that lands at the target location after 0.375 seconds, creating a field for 3 seconds that [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounds]] enemies within and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them.
description.text: Active: Singed spills a potent adhesive that lands at the target location after 0.375 seconds, creating a field for 3 seconds that grounds enemies within and slows them.

notes.raw: * The goo missile is a projectile. It has a fixed travel time but is independent from when the zone is established. It is destructible by effects such as [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]] and will destroy item spell shields if the goo missile is thrown past an enemy champion. * ''Mega Adhesive's'' [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] and [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|ground]] debuffs are each marked as non-dispellable, so they are not removed by most [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]]. Each is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that '''also''' grant immunity to the debuff type, such as [[File:Olaf OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf|An icon representing Olaf]] [[Olaf|Olaf's]] [[File:Olaf Ragnarok.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf#Ragnarok|An icon for Olaf's ability Ragnarok]] [[Olaf#Ragnarok|Ragnarok]].
notes.text:
The goo missile is a projectile. It has a fixed travel time but is independent from when the zone is established. It is destructible by effects such as Wind Wall and will destroy item spell shields if the goo missile is thrown past an enemy champion.
Mega Adhesive's slow and ground debuffs are each marked as non-dispellable, so they are not removed by most cleanses. Each is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that also grant immunity to the debuff type, such as Olaf's Ragnarok.
